name: gmail_archive
description: Archives one conversation of the user's Gmail: it leaves the inbox and stays in All Mail, so it can be found and moved back at any time. Use it when the user says to archive, clear or get a message out of the inbox, by its number from the last gmail_inbox. It does not delete anything (moving to the trash is gmail_trash) and does not reply. Returns one line confirming the conversation left the inbox; never repeat a call that succeeded.

number.description: Conversation number from the last gmail_inbox (e.g. 3).
